item.title: Pope Leo XIV celebrates open-air Mass in front of 800,000 people in central Paris
item.description: More than 800,000 people filled the streets of central Paris to hear Pope Leo XIV say Mass on Saturday, according to Vatican estimates. The pontiff rounded out the second day of his four-day apostolic visit to France by praying at the Grotto of Massabielle in Lourdes, a renowned pilgrimage site for Catholics from across the world.

item.title: Maricarmen Vs The ‘Vultures’: A “social tragedy” mobilising Spaniards
item.description: Protests are ongoing in Madrid right now, with many demonstrators holding signs and banners that read “Maricarmen vs the Vultures”. “Maricarmen, you are not alone.” Or “Ni una Maricarmen más.” Not one more Maricarmen.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV addresses youth at giant Paris Mass
item.description:
🇫🇷 🇻🇦 During #Pope Leo XIV's giant Mass at the Place de la Concorde in #Paris on Saturday, he spoke directly to Catholic youth, calling them the "Church of today".
The pontiff made efforts to connect with young people during his visit, holding a youth vigil at the Stade de #France on Friday.

item.title: Thousands march in Madrid to protest eviction of 87-year-old woman
item.description: The eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal on Wednesday sparked a thousands-strong protest in the streets of Madrid Saturday, with demonstrators calling for greater protection for tenants. Widespread anger at rising housing costs have put pressure on centre-left Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, whose government is expected to approve a package of pro-tenant measures in its next cabinet meeting.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV 600,000 people gather for Mass on the Champs-Élysées
item.description:
🇻🇦👀How do you get into one of the largest outdoor Mass in the world?
Pope Leo XIV celebrated an open-air Mass in front of hundreds of thousands of faithful on Saturday, September 26, in Paris.
France 24’s Stella Elgersma was there to tell you more! #Pope #France #LeoXIV
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 'A once-in-a-lifetime event': Faithful and curious flock to Pope Leo XIV's Mass in Paris
item.description: Some 700,000 people are estimated to have packed the Champs-Élysées and Place de la Concorde in Paris on Saturday for Pope Leo XIV's open-air Mass, the high point of his first official visit to France. Scouts, nuns, families and curious onlookers told FRANCE 24 why they came, from quiet prayer to hopes of spotting Canadian singer Céline Dion.

item.title: At least 16 people killed as Russia and Ukraine trade deadly air strikes
item.description: At least 16 people were killed over the past 24 hours as Russia and Ukraine traded deadly drone and missile strikes, authorities from both countries said Saturday. The UN has warned of rising civilian deaths as Kyiv and Moscow ramp up long-range strikes on critical infrastructure.

item.title: Brazil's President Lula bans online betting ahead of presidential election
item.description: Brazil’s President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on Friday signed an order banning fixed-odds betting just over a week ahead of the first round of the presidential election, in a move he said was designed to tackle the pervasive problem of families falling into debt.
